# `exports`-field fixtures

Stub packages for the `exports` field, exercised by `../../exports.js`.
Structure only, no vendored code: each `package.json` mirrors the `exports`
shape of a real, version-pinned npm package, and the files behind it are stubs
just real enough to be resolved.

The interesting cases are all about _precedence_ — which condition wins, and
what happens when the winner points at nothing.

| Package          | Mirrors                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Shape exercised                                                                                                                                                    |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `stringsugar`    | [`strip-ansi@7.2.0`](https://unpkg.com/strip-ansi@7.2.0/package.json), [`string-length@6.0.0`](https://unpkg.com/string-length@6.0.0/package.json)                                                                                                                                                                            | the sugar form: `exports` as a bare string instead of a map                                                                                                        |
| `condsugar`      | [`@humanwhocodes/retry@0.4.3`](https://unpkg.com/@humanwhocodes/retry@0.4.3/package.json)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | the sugar form for conditions: a condition map at the top level with no `"."` key, with legacy `main`/`module` agreeing with exports                               |
| `modernpkg`      | [`@humanwhocodes/module-importer@1.0.1`](https://unpkg.com/@humanwhocodes/module-importer@1.0.1/package.json), with the legacy `main`/`module` fields removed to model main-less publishing (cf. exports-only [`p-map@7.0.5`](https://unpkg.com/p-map@7.0.5/package.json))                                                    | the baseline `require`/`import` split, no legacy fields at all                                                                                                     |
| `typesfirst`     | [`ansi-escapes@7.3.0`](https://unpkg.com/ansi-escapes@7.3.0/package.json)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `types` listed first, a condition mendel must not match                                                                                                            |
| `ordered`        | hand-written per the Node.js resolution algorithm (`PACKAGE_TARGET_RESOLVE` iterates keys in object order; `default` matches unconditionally)                                                                                                                                                                                 | `default` declared _before_ `require`; condition order in the file is the resolution order, so `default` wins                                                      |
| `subpaths`       | [`react-dom@18.3.1`](https://unpkg.com/react-dom@18.3.1/package.json) (subpath map, conditional `./server`, `./package.json`); the `null` target follows the [Node.js packages doc](https://nodejs.org/docs/latest-v22.x/api/packages.html#package-entry-points) — no null-blocking package ships in this repo's node_modules | explicit subpaths, a per-condition subpath, `./package.json` re-exported, and `"./blocked": null` to make a subpath unreachable                                    |
| `@scope/pkg`     | scoped-package layout as in [`@babel/runtime@7.29.7`](https://unpkg.com/@babel/runtime@7.29.7/package.json)                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | the same subpath handling under a scoped name                                                                                                                      |
| `patterns`       | [`axios@1.16.0`](https://unpkg.com/axios@1.16.0/package.json) `"./unsafe/*": "./lib/*"` style                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | a `*` pattern target expanding into a different directory                                                                                                          |
| `catchall`       | [`chai@4.5.0`](https://unpkg.com/chai@4.5.0/package.json)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `"./*": "./*"`, the escape hatch that exposes the whole package, alongside a `"."` condition map and an extensionless legacy `main`                                |
| `arraytarget`    | [`@babel/runtime@7.29.7`](https://unpkg.com/@babel/runtime@7.29.7/package.json)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | exports-only with no `"."` entry (bare require blocked), an array of targets whose first entry is itself a condition map — the fallback form                       |
| `nested`         | [`axios@1.16.0`](https://unpkg.com/axios@1.16.0/package.json)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | conditions nested two deep (`browser` → `require`) next to an object-form `browser` map, with unknown conditions (`types`, `bun`, `react-native`) skipped in order |
| `nanoid-like`    | [`nanoid@3.3.18`](https://unpkg.com/nanoid@3.3.18/package.json)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `exports`, `browser` map, `main` and `module` all present and disagreeing, with `react-native` in the mix — the canonical dual package                             |
| `legacy-browser` | [`ws@8.21.0`](https://unpkg.com/ws@8.21.0/package.json), browser target deliberately divergent from the exports `browser` condition to pin mendel's browser-field overlay precedence                                                                                                                                          | a `browser` condition inside `exports` and a legacy top-level `browser` field pointing elsewhere, pinning which one wins                                           |
| `stale-main`     | hand-written; pins mendel's exports-over-main precedence when the legacy `main` points at a missing file                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | `main` pointing at a missing file while an `exports` condition is real                                                                                             |

`../legacy-fields/` is the companion catalog for packages with no `exports`
field at all.
